description: This file defines core metrics interfaces, options, and functions for the Prometheus client library in Go, including metric creation, description, and exemplar handling.

methods.name: BuildFQName
methods.description: Joins namespace, subsystem, and name with underscores to form a fully qualified metric name.

methods.name: NewInvalidMetric
methods.description: Creates a metric that always returns an error on write, used for reporting collection errors.

methods.name: NewMetricWithTimestamp
methods.description: Wraps a metric with an explicit timestamp.

methods.name: NewMetricWithExemplars
methods.description: Wraps a metric with provided exemplars, validating and converting them.

methods.name: MustNewMetricWithExemplars
methods.description: Panics on error, wraps a metric with exemplars.
